en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers rising above a tree‑filled square and surrounding buildings. At the front is a formal garden with paths and a statue. The caption at the bottom reads "Pécs" on the left and "Székesegyház" on the right. The reverse side has handwritten text in Hungarian, address lines, and a purple Hungarian stamp inscribed "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA" with a cancellation mark.
